name: PicBGRemover
tagline: Free private background removal in your browser with full-resolution PNG downloads
description: PicBGRemover removes image backgrounds directly in the browser. It is designed for people who need a clean transparent cutout without creating an account or sending the source image to the site server. The tool accepts JPG, PNG, and WebP files up to 20 MB, processes images on the user device, and provides a full-resolution transparent PNG download. It is useful for product photos, profile images, presentations, and other design workflows where privacy and a quick browser-based result matter.
